properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 11 at 7:25AM EDT until August 11 at 7:45AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
At 724 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Bluffton,
moving southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Emergency management. A wind gust to 63 MPH was reported
with this storm.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Bluffton, Berne, Nottingham, Poneto, Vera Cruz, Travisville, Linn
Grove, Domestic, Wellsburg, Reiffsburg, and Petroleum.
properties.instruction:
To report severe weather contact your nearest law enforcement agency.
They will send your report to the National Weather Service office in
Northern Indiana.
properties.area: Adams, IN; Jay, IN; Wells, IN

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Elkhart, Goshen, Warsaw, Nappanee, Winona Lake, Bremen, Ligonier,

from severe thunderstorms. If you spot a tornado go at once into the
basement or small central room in a sturdy structure.

For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...A portion of western Maryland, including the following
county, Garrett.

* WHEN...Until 200 PM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Roads remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings
are inundated with water and may not be passable. It will take
several hours for all the water from these storms to work
downstream.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 714 AM EDT, the Cassleman River level at Grantsville is at
7.1 feet and is still rising. Emergency Management reports
high water along the Cassleman River at Durst Road, Jennings
Road, Dung Hill Road, Bittinger Road, and Maple Grove Road.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected through mid morning.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bittinger...                       Grantsville...
Friendsville...                    Accident...
Jennings...                        Keysers Ridge...
New Germany...                     Mineral Spring...
Merrill...                         Selbysport...
Piney Grove...
- Please visit www.weather.gov/safety/flood for flood safety
and preparedness information.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
